newsitem.title: INDIA: MOTOROLA WINS INDIA BHARTI WIRELESS ORDER.
newsitem.headline: MOTOROLA WINS INDIA BHARTI WIRELESS ORDER.

text.p: India's Bharti Telenet Ltd said on Saturday it had placed a 1.7 billion-rupee order with U.S. Motorola Inc for wireless equipment.
Bharti said in a statement it had also awarded France's Alcatel Alsthom group a contract for switching equipment worth 1.75 billion rupees.

Telecom Italia Spa holds a 30 percent stake and India's Bharti Telecom Ltd 19 percent in Bharti Telenet Ltd, in which Bharti Televentures Ltd, a closely-held affiliate of the Bharti group, holds 51 percent.
Bharti Telenet is setting up in the central Indian state of Madhya Pradesh a basic telephone service network, for which it has won a licence from the Indian government.
Bharti officials said they expected the first telephone call to be made from the network by the end of the year.
